summary: vfscanf-style formatter that parses input characters from a buffered I/O context (a1) against a format string (a2), writing converted values through a variable-argument pointer (a3). Supports integer conversions (%d/%i/%u/%o/%x/%p), float conversions (%f/%e/%g), string (%s) and character-set (%{...}) scans, assignment suppression ('*'), width limits, length modifiers (h/l/w/I64), and %n. Returns the count of successful conversions, or -1 on EOF with no conversions.

local_names.a1: buffered I/O context handle whose next bytes are read via BufferedByteReader
local_names.a2: format string pointer, advanced as format tokens are consumed
local_names.a3: variable-argument list pointer; each non-suppressed conversion consumes one destination argument
local_names.v76: tracked count of characters consumed from the input stream (also the refcount that IncrementWrapperAroundCallLoop/ConditionalFreeIfHandleNot1 maintain per read)
local_names.v63: 64-bit integer accumulator used by I64 and integer conversions
local_names.v11: 32-bit integer accumulator used by default-width integer conversions
local_names.v54: 32-byte character bit-table built for %{...} scan sets
local_names.v62: current output destination pointer advanced as values are stored
local_names.v61: length marker: non-null when the I64 modifier selects the 64-bit storage path

operations.description: Character classification: for each pending format/input char, look up cbMultiByte (charset mode) to choose either the direct off_5E69C8 charset table or CharacterEncodingConvertViaLookupTableFallback; bit masks 8 (whitespace) and 4 (digit) drive whitespace-skip and digit accumulation

Whitespace skip: while the classified char is whitespace, consume the next format byte and skip matching input via sub_589BF3, tracking each consumed byte through IncrementWrapperAroundCallLoop and ConditionalFreeIfHandleNot1 on the context refcount

Non-conversion branch: when the next format char is not '%', read one input byte (BufferedByteReader), compare it to the expected literal, and on mismatch unwind the refcount via ConditionalFreeIfHandleNot1 and break the scan loop

Format-prefix parse: consume width digits into v74, handle '*' (suppress assignment), 'N'/'F' flags, the 'I64' modifier (advances v61, zeroes v63), and h/l/w length modifiers until a non-prefix char appears
Unless assignment is suppressed ('*'), consume one destination pointer from the argument list (a3 advances by 4) into v62 for the current conversion
First input read: for %c and %{ a BufferedByteReader call increments the consumed count, otherwise IncrementWrapperAroundCallLoop acquires the context; the read char is staged in the CharType slot
Width guard: if a width was specified (v64 set) but is zero (v74 == 0), push the read char back with ConditionalFreeIfHandleNot1 and break the scan

Integer conversions (%o/%u/%x/%p/%d/%i): accumulate digits using Allmul (x10 on the 64-bit accumulator), CRTAllshl (x8 octal, x16 hex, x4 when accumulating base-4), and sub_58EEF7 for hex-digit decoding; handle leading 0x/0X and octal prefixes, sign flags, width exhaustion and, on completion, store to v62 as QWORD (v61 set), DWORD (v73 length) or WORD

String and char conversions (%s, %S, %c): in wide mode (v68) convert each input byte to a wide char via sub_596716 before storing, using asc_5E6D50 as the wide-string format source and asc_5E6D58 for the %c path; otherwise store bytes directly through v62, NUL-terminating non-%c results

Scan-set conversion (%{...}): zero the 32-byte bit table v54 with sub_58BB10, expand character ranges and a leading '^' negation into bits, then read matching input bytes, honoring width and optional per-char wide conversion, until a non-matching byte is pushed back

Float conversions (%f/%e/%g): accumulate digit/exponent characters into a stack buffer, honoring the decimal separator byte_5E6BD8 and an e/E exponent with optional sign, then NUL-terminate and convert through the off_5E6738 function pointer, storing the result into the destination
%n conversion: store the current consumed-input count v76 into the destination argument instead of parsing input
On EOF (staged CharType == -1) return -1 when no conversions and no advances occurred; otherwise return the conversion count v60. Invoked by StrlenFormatCallWrapper (005887ED)

clean_pseudocode: if (*pos != '%') { read literal, compare, else break; continue; }
case 'c': case '{': read one input char; break;
case 'o': case 'u': case 'x': case 'p': case 'd': case 'i':
accumulate digits (base 8/10/16, hex decode, sign, 0x prefix) into acc;
store acc to dst (8/4/2 bytes by length);
build numeric string (digits, separator byte_5E6BD8, exponent), convert via off_5E6738;
read chars into dst, wide-convert if needed, NUL-terminate unless %c;
case '{': build scan-set bits, read matching chars;
case 'n': store consumed count into dst;
